about_the_game:
The Enigma Cases: Echoes of 9/11 – Shadows of the Past

This DLC expands the atmosphere of the main game with a historical layer.
A long-suppressed event resurfaces within a new murder case, bridging the gap between the past and the present.
Echoes of 9/11 invites players into an investigation where time itself becomes both an ally and an obstacle.

An Investigation Through Layers of Time

An event that took place on September 9, long forgotten and buried, can no longer remain hidden.
Players examine old police reports, government archives, and decaying evidence to uncover truths that span decades.
Each discovery reveals a connection between past mistakes and present consequences.

Where History Meets Detective Work

Echoes of 9/11 blends classic detective investigation with historical research.
Digital restoration, data analysis, and the re-evaluation of damaged records are key to solving the mystery.
This time, you’re not only uncovering a killer. You’re giving a voice to history itself.

The Echo of Truth Never Fades

Some secrets aren’t meant to be buried but remembered.
Echoes of 9/11 is more than a case. It’s a confrontation with forgotten justice.
Time moves forward, but the truth never truly disappears.

🔒 Requires the base game The Enigma Cases on Steam to play.

content_descriptors.notes:
Since our game is a detective game, there are different stories in each case.
For example, the cases focus on solving how the deceased people died, whether it was murder or suicide.

When we take the case and go to the scene where the victim died, we reach the adult content there.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 / AMD FX 4350
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: The echoes of the past are rising again. In the Echoes of 9/11 DLC, you’ll reopen a buried case and question the fragile balance between history, politics, and justice.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Hindi, Traditional Chinese
*languages with full audio support
